Use the mild-stage actions on this care plan, inspect nearby plants, and record a dated photo of the same leaf. Old spots may remain even when management is helping. Look for fewer new spots and healthy new growth. Follow the listed recheck steps. If damage spreads, plants wilt, or stems and fruits become affected, seek advice sooner. Suspected late blight still needs same-day advice even when damage looks mild.

Follow the urgency shown on screen. Even mild damage can need advice today or immediate help. You reported moderate damage. Start the moderate-stage actions, compare several plants, and keep a dated record of new symptoms. Management aims to protect healthy tissue; old dead patches will not turn green again. Use only a product registered for this crop and problem, and follow its label rather than choosing a dose from this app. Follow the recovery checks and contact a crop adviser if symptoms continue to spread.

Follow the urgency shown on screen. Even mild damage can need advice today or immediate help. You reported severe signs. Follow the severe-stage actions and arrange prompt crop advice. Wilting, dying plants, or rapid spread across many plants need an expert now. Do not wait for old damaged leaves to recover. Protect remaining healthy plants and record fresh symptoms for confirmation. Do not increase spray strength or mix products to force recovery. The care plan explains what to monitor while help is arranged.

Follow the urgency shown on screen. Even mild damage can need advice today or immediate help. There is not enough information to grade reported damage. Use the confirmation checks and answer the observation questions before selecting a stage plan. An uncertain answer is not the same as no damage. The treatment summary describes options if the disease is confirmed; it does not confirm the diagnosis. If plants are wilting, dying, or symptoms are spreading quickly, get local crop advice now. Suspected late blight needs advice today.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Inspect newly expanded leaves in several field locations and record whether new pustules are increasing. For expanding rust on susceptible young maize, ask for a crop-type and growth-stage fungicide decision using a locally maize-registered rust label. Look for this sign that management may be helping: New leaves develop fewer fresh pustules and green leaf area remains stable. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Walk the same field route and inspect lower, ear and upper leaves on plants in several locations; mark affected patches. If disease is moving toward the ear leaf around flowering, arrange a crop-stage-specific fungicide decision; any product must be locally registered for maize and gray leaf spot. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Fewer new rectangular lesions appear on previously clean ear and upper leaves. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is routine care for a healthy-looking crop, not proof that every problem is absent. A healthy-looking image does not rule out another problem; symptoms still need investigation. Inspect young leaves, the ear leaf and plant bases across several rows; record growth stage and field patches. If symptoms are present, photograph a fresh affected area, check soil moisture and recent spray/fertilizer history, and obtain a cause-specific assessment before treating. Look for this sign that management may be helping: New growth remains normal and marked plants develop no fresh symptoms. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Mark several affected plants and inspect the ear leaf and the next clean leaf at each visit. If lesions approach the ear leaf before or around flowering, arrange prompt confirmation and a maize-labeled fungicide decision based on crop stage and local risk. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Previously clean ear and upper leaves develop fewer new cigar-shaped lesions. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. On a dry day remove only a few heavily damaged lower leaves while retaining ample green foliage; collect them away from the crop and clean tools between plants. If fresh lesions keep appearing, confirmation should guide a locally registered early-blight fungicide program to protect clean tissue; rotate modes of action as the label directs. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Fewer fresh spots appear on leaves that were clean at the first dated photograph. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is routine care for a healthy-looking crop, not proof that every problem is absent. A healthy-looking image does not rule out another problem; symptoms still need investigation. Inspect leaves, stems and a sample of tubers when appropriate; check drainage and suspect seed history. If symptoms are present, photograph a fresh affected area, check soil moisture and recent spray/fertilizer history, and obtain a cause-specific assessment before treating. Look for this sign that management may be helping: New growth remains normal and marked plants develop no fresh symptoms. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Contact a local crop adviser today with fresh photos, crop stage and recent weather; inspect adjacent plants the same day rather than waiting for the next routine check. After confirmation, use only a locally registered late-blight program that targets oomycetes and protects clean foliage; an ordinary fungicide choice may be ineffective. Follow the exact crop label and resistance-management directions. Look for this sign that management may be helping: No new affected plants are found and photographed clean leaves stop developing fresh expanding patches. Contact a crop adviser today and inspect neighboring plants today. Do not wait 24 to 48 hours to seek help. Judge progress by fresh lesions and new affected plants.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Work healthy plants before suspect plants; postpone pruning, tying and harvesting while foliage is wet. After bacterial confirmation, discuss a tomato-registered bactericide/protectant; activity can be limited by resistance, so review local efficacy rather than repeating failed applications. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Fewer fresh leaf spots develop after dry-handling and splash-control changes. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

On a dry day remove only a few heavily damaged lower leaves while retaining ample green foliage; collect them away from the crop and clean tools between plants. If fresh lesions keep appearing, confirmation should guide a locally registered early-blight fungicide program to protect clean tissue; rotate modes of action as the label directs. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Fewer fresh spots appear on leaves that were clean at the first dated photograph. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is routine care for a healthy-looking crop, not proof that every problem is absent. A healthy-looking image does not rule out another problem; symptoms still need investigation. Inspect growing tips, leaf undersides, stems and fruit; look for mites, whiteflies, spots and wilting. If symptoms are present, photograph a fresh affected area, check soil moisture and recent spray/fertilizer history, and obtain a cause-specific assessment before treating. Look for this sign that management may be helping: New growth remains normal and marked plants develop no fresh symptoms. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Contact a local crop adviser today with fresh photos, crop stage and recent weather; inspect adjacent plants the same day rather than waiting for the next routine check. After confirmation, use only a locally registered late-blight program that targets oomycetes and protects clean foliage; an ordinary fungicide choice may be ineffective. Follow the exact crop label and resistance-management directions. Look for this sign that management may be helping: No new affected plants are found and photographed clean leaves stop developing fresh expanding patches. Contact a crop adviser today and inspect neighboring plants today. Do not wait 24 to 48 hours to seek help. Judge progress by fresh lesions and new affected plants.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Ventilate the protected structure to reduce condensation, maintain spacing and irrigate the root zone early enough for foliage to dry. If new underside mold continues after humidity correction, confirm leaf mold and select a locally registered tomato leaf-mold fungicide; protected-crop labels may differ from open-field labels. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Less overnight condensation and fewer new underside mold patches on clean leaves. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. No spray removes this virus from an infected plant. Mark suspect plants and handle healthy plants first; wash hands and change or clean gloves before returning to clean plants. After confirmation, discuss removal of individual infected plants and contained disposal, using clean tools and avoiding contact with healthy plants. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Previously symptom-free plants remain free of new mosaic after handling hygiene is improved. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. When foliage is dry, remove a few heavily affected lower leaves and remove leaves lying on soil; leave enough green canopy. If clean leaves develop new spots, confirm Septoria and discuss a tomato-registered protective fungicide program; protection of clean foliage matters more than changing old spots. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Lower-leaf yellowing and drop slow, with fewer fresh spots on the next clean leaf. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Spider mites are pests, not a fungal disease. Fungicide will not control them, and old bronzed leaves may stay damaged. Inspect undersides of leaves from several hot, dusty field patches; mark affected plants and compare live mite numbers on the same leaves. For confirmed increasing mites, consider a tomato-labeled mite treatment with underside coverage. A labeled horticultural oil or insecticidal soap can injure heat- or drought-stressed plants; test and follow label restrictions. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Live moving mites and fresh webbing decline on comparable sampled leaves. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. Existing dead or damaged tissue may not recover; protect healthy growth. Mark suspect plants and inspect fruit hidden inside the canopy, not only the photographed outer leaf. When new lesions continue or fruit is affected, obtain diagnostic confirmation and a locally registered tomato target-spot fungicide plan; follow mode-of-action rotation and harvest restrictions. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Fresh lesions decline on previously clean inner leaves and newly developing fruit. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

This is conditional care for the suspected condition. Confirm the cause before disease-specific treatment; urgent advice and low-risk care need not wait. No spray removes this virus from an infected plant. Mark suspect plants, inspect nearby new growth and whiteflies, and arrange confirmation before removing plants. Whitefly management aims to reduce future transmission, not cure infected plants. Select a locally tomato-registered vector option and conserve natural enemies; repeatedly using one insecticide increases resistance risk. Look for this sign that management may be helping: Fewer previously clean plants develop new curl symptoms and vector pressure declines. Follow the urgency shown on screen. Mark the same plants and use dated photos. If stable, compare fresh symptoms within 24 to 48 hours; seek help earlier if worsening.

ಪರದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದ ತುರ್ತು ಸೂಚನೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿಯಿದ್ದರೂ ಇಂದೇ ಸಲಹೆ ಅಥವಾ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕಾಗಬಹುದು. ನೀವು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಿ. ಈ ಆರೈಕೆ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿಯ ಕ್ರಮ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಹತ್ತಿರದ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ಅದೇ ಎಲೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಚಿತ್ರ ಉಳಿಸಿ. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದರೂ ಹಳೆಯ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಉಳಿಯಬಹುದು. ಹೊಸ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿವೆಯೇ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ನೋಡಿ. ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಮರುಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಹಾನಿ ಹರಡಿದರೆ, ಗಿಡ ಬಾಡಿದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕಾಂಡ ಮತ್ತು ಹಣ್ಣಿಗೆ ಹಾನಿಯಾದರೆ ಬೇಗ ಸಲಹೆ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ. ತಡವಾದ ಅಂಗಮಾರಿ ಶಂಕೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿಯಿದ್ದರೂ ಇಂದೇ ಸಲಹೆ ಬೇಕು.

ಪರದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದ ತುರ್ತು ಸೂಚನೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿಯಿದ್ದರೂ ಇಂದೇ ಸಲಹೆ ಅಥವಾ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕಾಗಬಹುದು. ನೀವು ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಹಾನಿ ಇದೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಿ. ಮಧ್ಯಮ ಹಾನಿಯ ಕ್ರಮ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ, ಹಲವು ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹೊಸ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ದಾಖಲೆ ಇಡಿ. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಭಾಗ ರಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಹಳೆಯ ಸತ್ತ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತೆ ಹಸಿರಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಈ ಬೆಳೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ನೋಂದಾಯಿತ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಸಿ. ಆಪ್‌ನಿಂದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಬದಲು ಲೇಬಲ್ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಚೇತರಿಕೆಯ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಹರಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಲಹೆಗಾರರನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ.

ಪರದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದ ತುರ್ತು ಸೂಚನೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿಯಿದ್ದರೂ ಇಂದೇ ಸಲಹೆ ಅಥವಾ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕಾಗಬಹುದು. ನೀವು ತೀವ್ರ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳಿವೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಿ. ತೀವ್ರ ಹಾನಿಯ ಕ್ರಮ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಬೆಳೆ ಸಲಹೆ ಪಡೆಯಲು ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಗಿಡಗಳು ಬಾಡುವುದು, ಸಾಯುವುದು ಅಥವಾ ಅನೇಕ ಗಿಡಗಳಿಗೆ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಹರಡುವುದು ಇದ್ದರೆ ಈಗಲೇ ತಜ್ಞರ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕು. ಹಳೆಯ ಹಾನಿಯಾದ ಎಲೆ ಚೇತರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಕಾಯಬೇಡಿ. ಉಳಿದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿ, ಹೊಸ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ. ಚೇತರಿಕೆಗಾಗಿ ಸಿಂಪಡಣೆಯ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಬೇಡಿ ಅಥವಾ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆರೆಸಬೇಡಿ. ಸಹಾಯ ಬರುವವರೆಗೆ ಗಮನಿಸಬೇಕಾದವು ಯೋಜನೆಯಲ್ಲಿವೆ.

ಪರದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೋರಿಸಿದ ತುರ್ತು ಸೂಚನೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ಕಡಿಮೆ ಹಾನಿಯಿದ್ದರೂ ಇಂದೇ ಸಲಹೆ ಅಥವಾ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕಾಗಬಹುದು. ಹಾನಿಯ ಮಟ್ಟ ತಿಳಿಯಲು ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಸಾಕಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ರೋಗ ದೃಢೀಕರಣದ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಂತದ ಯೋಜನೆ ಆರಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಗಮನಿಸುವಿಕೆಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರಿಸಿ. ಖಚಿತವಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದರೆ ಹಾನಿ ಇಲ್ಲ ಎಂದಲ್ಲ. ರೋಗ ದೃಢಪಟ್ಟರೆ ಇರುವ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಯ ಸಾರಾಂಶ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅದು ರೋಗವನ್ನು ದೃಢಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಗಿಡಗಳು ಬಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ, ಸಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ವೇಗವಾಗಿ ಹರಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ಈಗಲೇ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಕೃಷಿ ಸಲಹೆ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ. ತಡವಾದ ಅಂಗಮಾರಿ ಶಂಕೆಗೆ ಇಂದೇ ಸಲಹೆ ಬೇಕು.

ಇದು ಅನುಮಾನಿತ ಕಾರಣದ ಷರತ್ತುಬದ್ಧ ಆರೈಕೆ. ರೋಗ-ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಕಾರಣ ದೃಢಪಡಿಸಿ; ತುರ್ತು ಸಲಹೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಅಪಾಯದ ಆರೈಕೆಗೆ ಕಾಯಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ. ಹಳೆಯ ಸತ್ತ ಅಥವಾ ಹಾನಿಯಾದ ಭಾಗ ಗುಣವಾಗದೇ ಇರಬಹುದು; ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿ. ಹಲವು ಹೊಲ ಸ್ಥಳಗಳ ಹೊಸ ಎಲೆ ನೋಡಿ; ಹೊಸ ತುಕ್ಕು ಕಲೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತಿದೆಯೇ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ. ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ರೋಗ ಬರುವ ಎಳೆಯ ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ತುಕ್ಕು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಅಥವಾ ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ತಕ್ಕ, ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ನೋಂದಣಿಯ ತುಕ್ಕು ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಿರಬಹುದೆಂಬ ಈ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ನೋಡಿ: ಹೊಸ ಎಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ತುಕ್ಕು ಕಲೆ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಿ ಹಸಿರು ಭಾಗ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುವುದು. ಪರದೆಯ ತುರ್ತು ಆದ್ಯತೆ ಪಾಲಿಸಿ. ಒಂದೇ ಗಿಡ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಚಿತ್ರ ಇಡಿ. ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಇಪ್ಪತ್ತನಾಲ್ಕರಿಂದ ನಲವತ್ತೆಂಟು ಗಂಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಲಕ್ಷಣ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ; ಹದಗೆಟ್ಟರೆ ಬೇಗ ನೆರವು ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ.

स्क्रीन पर बताई तात्कालिकता मानें। हल्के नुकसान में भी आज सलाह या तुरंत मदद की जरूरत हो सकती है। आपने हल्का नुकसान बताया है। इस देखभाल योजना में हल्के नुकसान वाले कदम अपनाएँ, आसपास के पौधों की जाँच करें और उसी पत्ते की तारीख वाली तस्वीर रखें। प्रबंधन से फायदा होने पर भी पुराने धब्बे रह सकते हैं। देखें कि नए धब्बे कम हो रहे हैं और नई बढ़वार स्वस्थ है या नहीं। बताए गए समय पर फिर जाँचें। नुकसान फैले, पौधे मुरझाएँ या तने और फल प्रभावित हों तो पहले सलाह लें। पछेती झुलसा की आशंका में हल्के नुकसान पर भी आज ही सलाह चाहिए।
